title: Volcanoes of Asia (timed)
intro: 10 volcanoes of Asia, one after another. You have 45 seconds for each place; at zero your marker is locked in. The map shows coasts, rivers, lakes and borders, and you work inside this area.

rounds.name: Mount Erciyes
